Definition: properly, apparently, to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) valuable; causatively, to make rare (figuratively, to inhibit)
BiblicalUsage: Yâqar is the verb for counting something precious, for holding it dear. David behaved so wisely that his name was much set by among the servants of Saul, and the third captain begged Elijah to let his life be precious in the prophet's sight.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a life held precious is a life spared, and the captain who knelt was saved by the value he placed on mercy.
